# SQLite3 из исходников
project(sqlite3_bundled LANGUAGES C)

set(SQLITE3_SRC_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
set(SQLITE3_INCLUDE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

# Компилируем SQLite3
if(BUILD_STATIC_SQLITE)
    add_library(sqlite3 STATIC ${SQLITE3_SRC_DIR}/sqlite3.c)
    message(STATUS "Building SQLite3 as static library")
else()
    add_library(sqlite3 SHARED ${SQLITE3_SRC_DIR}/sqlite3.c)
    message(STATUS "Building SQLite3 as shared library")
endif()

# Настройки компиляции
target_compile_definitions(sqlite3 PRIVATE
    SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1
    SQLITE_USE_URI=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA=1
)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(sqlite3 PRIVATE 
        /W0  # Отключаем предупреждения
    )
else()
    target_compile_options(sqlite3 PRIVATE 
        -w    # Отключаем предупреждения
        -O2   # Оптимизация
        -fPIC # Position Independent Code
    )
endif()

# Публичный интерфейс
target_include_directories(sqlite3 PUBLIC 
    ${SQLITE3_INCLUDE_DIR}
)

# Установить выходную директорию
set_target_properties(sqlite3 PROPERTIES
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin
)
